product_overview: A bilingual (AR/EN) marketing-first site for Eagle Car Rental that showcases the fleet, captures leads via forms and a persistent WhatsApp CTA, and provides content for SEO and customer trust. The first release focuses on browsing, enquiries and structured booking requests (no live availability or payments).
core_goals: Allow visitors to browse the public vehicle fleet and learn starting prices and specs
Capture firm, structured rental requests (lead-first booking requests) that the team can follow up on
Provide a clear, persistent WhatsApp conversion path from any page to accelerate lead conversion
Enable visitors to submit general enquiries and view current offers and FAQs
Support bilingual content (Arabic / English) and SEO-friendly public pages

features.name: Fleet Explorer
features.description: Browse the available vehicles, scan price-from badges and narrow results using filters to find candidates for a rental.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet -> Scroll through car list and review vehicle summaries and starting prices -> Use available filters to narrow choices by class or price band -> Select a vehicle card to open its detail summary -> Initiate a booking request or enquiry for the selected vehicle

features.name: Car Booking (lead-first booking request)
features.description: Submit a structured booking request for a chosen vehicle; requests are stored and sent to the team for manual confirmation (no live availability or payment in V1).
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet -> Select a vehicle from the listing to start a booking request -> Fill in pickup and dropoff dates -> Select pickup and dropoff locations -> Provide name and contact details and any rental preferences -> Provide budget band or preferred car if applicable -> Submit booking request -> See on-site confirmation and a WhatsApp CTA to continue the conversation

features.name: Booking form validation (user-correctable error flow)
features.description: Client-side validation prevents submitting incomplete booking requests and prompts the user to correct missing fields.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/fleet -> Select a vehicle and start a booking request -> Attempt to submit the form with missing required fields (e.g., missing dates) -> See inline validation messages for the missing fields -> Complete the missing fields -> Submit booking request -> See on-site confirmation

features.name: Inquiry Submission (Contact form)
features.description: Send general enquiries or custom requests via the contact form; submissions are stored and forwarded to the team with context for follow-up.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/contact -> Fill in name, email, and message and optionally provide residency type, preferred date, and budget -> Submit inquiry -> See in-page confirmation and a WhatsApp CTA to continue the conversation

features.name: Inquiry form validation (user-correctable error flow)
features.description: Client-side validation ensures required contact details are present before sending an inquiry.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/contact -> Attempt to submit the form without an email or name -> See inline validation messages prompting completion -> Provide the required details -> Submit inquiry -> See confirmation

features.name: Persistent WhatsApp Conversion CTA
features.description: A site-wide CTA that opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message referencing the current page to accelerate direct conversations with the sales team.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale] or any public page (e.g., /[locale]/fleet or /[locale]/offers) -> Use the persistent WhatsApp CTA -> Observe a prefilled message that includes page context -> Send the prefilled message in WhatsApp to start a conversation with the team

features.name: Offers Browsing
features.description: Surface current promotions and special rates so visitors can review and reference offers in enquiries or WhatsApp conversations.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/offers -> Scan listed offers and starting prices -> Open an offer summary to review details -> Use the WhatsApp CTA or submit an inquiry referencing the offer to request booking or more information

features.name: Login & Dashboard (authenticated booking management)
features.description: Allow returning users to sign in and view a dashboard with their saved requests or bookings for management and follow-up.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/login -> Provide email and password -> Submit login form -> See /[locale]/dashboard with a list of the user's booking requests and their statuses

features.name: FAQ & About content
features.description: Provide trust-building content (requirements, insurance basics, delivery/collection options, and company information) to answer common visitor questions and reduce friction.
user_flows: Navigate to /[locale]/faq -> Read FAQ entries relevant to residency, documentation, and delivery options
Navigate to /[locale]/about -> Read company positioning and trust elements
